notes: LED KEYBOARDS light up with the app's colors. New in Settings > MIDI: Key lights — 'Played notes' lights every key you play on the LED output, 'Whole scale layout' keeps the full in-scale layout lit (root brightest, chord tones next; works on any keyboard that lights incoming notes). ROLI LUMI (USB or Bluetooth): the sync was rebuilt against the community SysEx documentation — the old key/scale encoding was actually wrong — and now also pushes the app's DEGREE COLORS (root = degree-1 color, in-scale keys = degree-5 color) plus a light-mode picker (Scale colors / Rainbow / Piano / Night). Editing the fretboard palette re-colors the LUMI live. Also fixes a v0.56 service-worker install bug that could keep web installs from updating.
